title: Session-consistent shadow-to-live pipeline with graceful cutover and rollback rehearsal
author: Maya Rodriguez
description: Implements a session-consistent shadow-to-live pipeline that allows controlled cutover from shadow traffic to live traffic while running a periodic rollback rehearsal to validate rollback playbooks and snapshot restore behavior. Motivation: we observed sessions breaking when promoted from shadow lanes in mixed-state caches during a recent canary; this PR ensures session affinity and KV-cache coherence are preserved during promotion and during an automated rollback exercise. Design highlights include: a two-phase shadow sink that tracks session tokens and sticky routing keys; a cutover coordinator that performs a staged release with soft-holdpoints and telemetry gates; a rollback rehearsal harness that replays a bounded window of traffic to exercise snapshot restore and snapshot promotion paths without impacting production; and a small state-machine extension to the rollout controller exposing rehearse/run/freeze states. This PR adds deterministic smoke-simulation for canaries, per-session TTL reconciliation, and a metric-based guard that aborts promotion if session loss or 5xx regressions exceed thresholds. Backwards compatibility: compatible with existing canary lanes and shadow captures; operators can opt-in by setting rollout.spec.session_consistent=true. Testing: local simulation, CI integration tests, and a dedicated canary lab run were used; one flaky e2e was retried in CI and passed. Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] rollout simulation harness, [x] docs update; followups: wire the new rollout flag into Redwood Console toggles, add runbook entries for rehearsals, extend telemetry dashboards for rehearsal runs.

review_comments: Arjun Mehta: Nice end-to-end approach; can you clarify how the sink backpressure interacts with autoscaler during prolonged rehearse runs?

Maya Rodriguez: Autoscaler is unaffected; sink applies per-session rate limiting and emits 'rehearse.backpressure' metric so autoscaler logic ignores rehearsal pods via rollout labels; added note in coordinator docs.
Sofia Nguyen: Integration test failing intermittently on TTL reconciliation; observed race when session update coincides with snapshot commit. Requested: add linearizable commit in reconciler.
Maya Rodriguez: Added a retry+compare loop and a unit test to cover race; integration rerun in CI passed.
Omar Alvarez: Approve after CI passes and a short smoke in the canary lab; left a minor nits comment on log verbosity.
Maya Rodriguez: Addressed nits; reduced debug-level logs and added structured fields for session_id and rollout_id; canary lab smoke run attached in CI artifacts.
release_notes: Adds session-consistent shadow pipeline with staged cutover and a rollback rehearsal harness; operators can opt-in via rollout.spec.session_consistent flag; improves safety of shadow promotions and exercise rollback playbooks in non-disruptive rehearsals; includes rollout controller state extension and observability for rehearsal runs.
notes_for_ops: To enable, set rollout.spec.session_consistent=true and deploy helm overlay canary-rehearse; rehearsal runs are scheduled via /api/v1/rollouts/:id/rehearse endpoint and are labeled rollout=rehersal to avoid autoscaler interference; see docs/rollouts/session_shadow_cutover.md and runbook entries; rehearsal artifacts are stored under s3://redwood-rehearsal-artifacts/<rollout-id>.
